---
title: "Figure & Table Generation — Proposal and Technical Appendix"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      dev = "ragg_png", dpi = 300)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(webshot2)
library(scales)

proj_root <- normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), ".."))
data_dir  <- file.path(proj_root, "data")
img_dir   <- file.path(proj_root, "output")
dir.create(img_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

model_order_9 <- c(
  "Claude Sonnet", "Claude Opus", "Claude Haiku",
  "GPT-5.6 terra", "GPT-5.6 sol", "GPT-5.6 luna",
  "Gemini 3.1 Pro", "Gemini 3.5 Flash",
  "Qwen3-32B"
)

gt_save_png <- function(gt_tbl, filename, vw = 1000, vh = 600) {
  gtsave(gt_tbl, file.path(img_dir, filename), vwidth = vw, vheight = vh)
}

gt_theme <- function(gt_tbl) {
  gt_tbl %>%
    tab_options(
      table.font.size        = px(13),
      heading.title.font.size = px(16),
      heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.subtitle.font.size = px(12),
      column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
      column_labels.padding     = px(10),
      column_labels.font.size   = px(12),
      data_row.padding           = px(8),
      source_notes.font.size    = px(10),
      footnotes.font.size       = px(10),
      table.width               = pct(100)
    ) %>%
    opt_align_table_header(align = "center") %>%
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_fill(color = "#4a4a4a"),
        cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
      ),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_fill(color = "#4a4a4a"),
        cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
      ),
      locations = cells_column_spanners()
    )
}
```

# Part 1: Proposal Tables

## Figure 2: Persona Diagnostic Test System (`table_A_test_system.png`)

```{r table-A-test-system}
df_test_system <- tibble::tibble(
  num  = c("(1)", "(2)", "(3)"),
  test = c("Persona Expression Test",
           "Persona Nomological Test",
           "Persona Belief-Update Test"),
  what = c("Persona spec → Attribute X",
           "Attribute X → Behavior Y",
           "Counter-argument → Belief update"),
  validity = c("Manipulation validity—does the\nspec establish the intended attribute?",
               "Nomological validity—does X→Y follow\ntheoretical predictions? (Cronbach & Meehl 1955)",
               "Deliberation fitness—does the persona\nupdate beliefs proportionally to evidence?")
)

tbl_A <- df_test_system %>%
  gt() %>%
  gt_theme() %>%
  cols_label(
    num      = "",
    test     = "Test",
    what     = "What It Verifies",
    validity = "Validity Type"
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    num      ~ px(50),
    test     ~ px(250),
    what     ~ px(280),
    validity ~ px(400)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = num)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#f9f9f9"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = c(2))
  )

gt_save_png(tbl_A, "table_A_test_system.png", vw = 1000, vh = 400)
tbl_A
```

## Table 1: Behavioral Diagnostic Test Results — 11 Models (`table1_diagnostic.png`)

```{r table1-diagnostic}
df_t1 <- tibble::tibble(
  model     = c("Claude Sonnet", "Claude Opus", "Claude Haiku",
                "GPT-5.6 terra", "GPT-5.6 sol", "GPT-5.6 luna",
                "Gemini 3.1 Pro", "Gemini 3.5 Flash",
                "Qwen3-32B", "GPT-OSS 120B", "Swallow-70B"),
  provider  = c("Anthropic", "Anthropic", "Anthropic",
                "OpenAI", "OpenAI", "OpenAI",
                "Google", "Google",
                "Alibaba", "OpenAI", "TokyoTech/AIST\n(Llama 3 base)"),
  type      = c(rep("Proprietary", 8), rep("Open-weight", 3)),
  test1     = c("Pass (7/7, 0%)", "Pass (6/7, 0%)", "Pass (7/7, 0%)",
                "Pass (6/7, 0%)", "Pass (5/7, 0%)", "Pass (6/7, 0%)",
                "Pass (7/7, 3%)", "Pass (7/7, 0%)",
                "Fail (5/7, textbook 17%)", "Fail†", "Fail†"),
  test2     = c("Pass", "Pass", "Pass",
                "Pass", "Pass", "Pass",
                "Pass", "Pass",
                "Pass", "—", "—"),
  test3     = c("Pass", "Pass", "Fail (acquiescent:\nweak 22%)",
                "Pass", "Pass", "Fail (weak\nviolation 3%)",
                "Pass", "Pass",
                "Fail (rigid:\nstrong 6%)", "Indiscriminate†", "Pass†"),
  verdict   = c("Qualified", "Qualified", "Not qualified",
                "Qualified", "Qualified", "Not qualified",
                "Qualified", "Qualified",
                "Not qualified", "Not qualified", "Not qualified"),
  is_fail_t1 = c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),
  is_fail_t3 = c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE)
)

tbl_1 <- df_t1 %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_hide(columns = c(is_fail_t1, is_fail_t3)) %>%
  gt_theme() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Table 1. Behavioral Diagnostic Test Results: 11 Models") %>%
  cols_label(
    model    = "Model",
    provider = "Provider",
    type     = "Model Type",
    test1    = "Test 1:\nExpression",
    test2    = "Test 2:\nNomological",
    test3    = "Test 3:\nBelief Update",
    verdict  = "Overall\nVerdict"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = model)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(color = "#c62828", weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_body(columns = test1, rows = is_fail_t1)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(color = "#c62828", weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_body(columns = test3, rows = is_fail_t3)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = verdict, rows = verdict == "Qualified")
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#f9f9f9"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10))
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(md(
    "Test 1 values: splitting rate (discriminating facts with minority ≥10%) and textbook-order rate.<br>
    Test 2: all 9 standardized models passed (attributes reach behavior in predicted direction; zero forbidden-pathway violations).<br>
    Test 3: \"Acquiescent\" = yields to baseless pressure; \"Rigid\" = unmoved by strong evidence; \"Indiscriminate\" = equal change regardless of quality.<br>
    † Tested on preliminary instrument version."
  ))

gt_save_png(tbl_1, "table1_diagnostic.png", vw = 1100, vh = 800)
tbl_1
```

## Table 2: Calibration Effect (`table2_calibration.png`)

```{r table2-calibration}
df_t2 <- tibble::tibble(
  model    = c("Claude Sonnet", "GPT-5.6 terra", "Claude Opus"),
  provider = c("Anthropic", "OpenAI", "Anthropic"),
  type     = c("Proprietary", "Proprietary", "Proprietary"),
  wt_high  = c("1.08", "1.08", "—"),
  wt_low   = c("3.25", "3.08", "—"),
  pval     = c("0.0001", "0.0001", "< 0.001")
)

tbl_2 <- df_t2 %>%
  gt() %>%
  gt_theme() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Table 2. Calibration Effect: Strategy Choice by Risk Aversion Level") %>%
  cols_label(
    model    = "Model",
    provider = "Provider",
    type     = "Model Type",
    wt_high  = "WT Strategy Rank\n(High Risk Aversion)",
    wt_low   = "WT Strategy Rank\n(Low Risk Aversion)",
    pval     = "p-value"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = model)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#f9f9f9"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = 2)
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(md(
    "WT strategy rank on a 4-point scale (1 = top priority, 4 = lowest). High risk-aversion personas prioritize the WT (defensive) strategy; low risk-aversion personas deprioritize it. Calibration converged in 2 iterations for all models."
  ))

gt_save_png(tbl_2, "table2_calibration.png", vw = 1000, vh = 400)
tbl_2
```

## Study 1 Descriptive Statistics (`appendix_study1_descriptive.png`)

```{r study1-descriptive}
fs <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "fact_splitting.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
bu <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "belief_update.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
bs <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "battery_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# --- Test 1: Role Divergence (discriminating fact minority-vote M±SD) ---
role_div <- fs %>%
  filter(fact_set == "判別") %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(mean_min = mean(minority_pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(role_div_label = sprintf("%.1f%%", mean_min * 100))

# --- Test 1: Rote Response (textbook order rate) ---
rote <- bs %>%
  select(model, provider, textbook_rate) %>%
  mutate(rote_label = sprintf("%.0f%%", textbook_rate * 100))

# --- Test 2: Nomological (self-report vs behavioral % significant) ---
law_base <- file.path(proj_root, "persona_generic", "results")
law_models <- tribble(
  ~dir_key, ~model_label,
  "law_sakura_sonnet",        "Claude Sonnet",
  "law_sakura_opus",          "Claude Opus",
  "law_sakura_haiku",         "Claude Haiku",
  "law_sakura_gpt56terra",    "GPT-5.6 terra",
  "law_sakura_gpt56sol",      "GPT-5.6 sol",
  "law_sakura_gpt56luna",     "GPT-5.6 luna",
  "law_sakura_gemini31pro",   "Gemini 3.1 Pro",
  "law_sakura_gemini35flash", "Gemini 3.5 Flash",
  "law_sakura_qwen32b",       "Qwen3-32B"
)

law_rows <- pmap_dfr(law_models, function(dir_key, model_label) {
  fpath <- file.path(law_base, dir_key, "summary.json")
  if (!file.exists(fpath)) return(NULL)
  d <- jsonlite::fromJSON(fpath)
  attrs <- d$attributes
  map_dfr(names(attrs), function(a) {
    measures <- attrs[[a]]$measures
    map_dfr(names(measures), function(m) {
      tibble(model = model_label, attribute = a, measure = m, p_value = measures[[m]]$p)
    })
  })
})

nomo <- law_rows %>%
  filter(measure %in% c("scale", "rank_SO")) %>%
  group_by(model, measure) %>%
  summarise(pct_sig = mean(p_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = pct_sig) %>%
  rename(scale_pct = scale, behav_pct = rank_SO) %>%
  mutate(
    scale_label = sprintf("%.0f%%", scale_pct * 100),
    behav_label = sprintf("%.0f%%", behav_pct * 100)
  )

# --- Test 3: Belief Update (strong evidence + peer pressure) ---
bu_key <- bu %>%
  filter(probe_type %in% c("strong", "majority")) %>%
  select(model, probe_type, change_rate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = probe_type, values_from = change_rate) %>%
  mutate(
    strong_label = sprintf("%.0f%%", strong * 100),
    majority_label = sprintf("%.0f%%", majority * 100)
  )

# --- Weak Δ exceptions for footnote ---
bu_weak <- bu %>%
  filter(probe_type == "weak", change_rate > 0) %>%
  mutate(note = sprintf("%s (%.0f%%)", model, change_rate * 100))
weak_note <- paste(bu_weak$note, collapse = ", ")

# --- Combine ---
desc <- rote %>%
  left_join(role_div %>% select(model, role_div_label), by = "model") %>%
  left_join(nomo %>% select(model, scale_label, behav_label), by = "model") %>%
  left_join(bu_key %>% select(model, strong_label, majority_label, strong, majority),
            by = "model") %>%
  mutate(
    model = factor(model, levels = model_order_9),
    is_rote_fail = textbook_rate > 0.10,
    is_strong_fail = strong < 0.15,
    is_majority_fail = majority > 0.50
  ) %>%
  arrange(model) %>%
  select(model, provider, role_div_label, rote_label, scale_label, behav_label,
         strong_label, majority_label,
         is_rote_fail, is_strong_fail, is_majority_fail)

tbl_desc <- desc %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_hide(columns = c(is_rote_fail, is_strong_fail, is_majority_fail)) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(13), heading.title.font.size = px(16),
    heading.title.font.weight = "bold", heading.subtitle.font.size = px(12),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold", column_labels.padding = px(10),
    column_labels.font.size = px(12), data_row.padding = px(8),
    source_notes.font.size = px(10), table.width = pct(100)
  ) %>%
  opt_align_table_header(align = "center") %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#ffffff"), cell_text(color = "#333333", weight = "bold")),
            locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#ffffff"), cell_text(color = "#333333", weight = "bold")),
            locations = cells_column_spanners()) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Study 1 Descriptive Statistics: 9 Models (Sakura Foods Case)",
    subtitle = "Fictional case — standardized diagnostic instrument (204 API calls per model)"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    model = "Model", provider = "Provider",
    role_div_label = "Role\nDivergence",
    rote_label = "Rote\nResponse",
    scale_label = "Self-Report",
    behav_label = "Behavioral",
    strong_label = md("Evidence<br>Based"),
    majority_label = md("Majority<br>Based")
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    model ~ px(150), provider ~ px(90),
    role_div_label ~ px(100), rote_label ~ px(85),
    scale_label ~ px(100), behav_label ~ px(100),
    strong_label ~ px(100), majority_label ~ px(100)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(role_div_label, rote_label, scale_label,
             behav_label, strong_label, majority_label)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Test 1: Expression", columns = c(role_div_label, rote_label)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Test 2: Nomological", columns = c(scale_label, behav_label)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Test 3: Belief Update", columns = c(strong_label, majority_label)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = model)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(color = "#c62828", weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = rote_label, rows = is_rote_fail)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(color = "#c62828", weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = strong_label, rows = is_strong_fail)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(color = "#c62828", weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = majority_label, rows = is_majority_fail)) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#f9f9f9"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = c(2, 4, 6, 8))
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(md(paste0(
    "**Role Divergence**: mean minority-vote % across 7 discriminating facts (30 personas); higher = greater persona-driven differentiation.<br>",
    "**Rote Response**: % of personas returning strategies in presentation order (SO>ST>WO>WT); threshold ≤ 10%.<br>",
    "**Self-Report / Behavioral**: proportion of 7 attributes with significant high-low effects (p < .05) on questionnaire vs. strategy ranking; the gap reveals silent failure.<br>",
    "**Evidence Based**: position change rate when presented with case-specific counter-evidence; threshold > 15%.<br>",
    "**Majority Based**: change rate when told all others classified differently; threshold < 50%.<br>",
    "Red = exceeds failure threshold. Weak-argument change rate was 0% for all models except ", weak_note,
    ". Control facts: all models showed ≤ 2% splitting, confirming internal validity."
  )))

gt_save_png(tbl_desc, "appendix_study1_descriptive.png", vw = 1050, vh = 650)
tbl_desc
```

## Figure A2: Behavioral Diagnostic Results (`appendix_diagnostic_scorecard.png`)

```{r diagnostic-scorecard, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
models_qualified <- c("Claude Sonnet", "Claude Opus", "GPT-5.6 terra",
                       "GPT-5.6 sol", "Gemini 3.1 Pro", "Gemini 3.5 Flash")
models_disqualified <- c("Claude Haiku", "GPT-5.6 luna", "Qwen3-32B")
model_order <- c(models_qualified, models_disqualified)

sc <- tribble(
  ~model, ~test, ~result, ~label,
  "Claude Sonnet",    "Test 1: Expression",    "Pass", "Pass",
  "Claude Sonnet",    "Test 2: Nomological",   "Pass", "Pass",
  "Claude Sonnet",    "Test 3: Belief Update",  "Pass", "Pass",
  "Claude Opus",      "Test 1: Expression",    "Pass", "Pass",
  "Claude Opus",      "Test 2: Nomological",   "Pass", "Pass",
  "Claude Opus",      "Test 3: Belief Update",  "Pass", "Pass",
  "GPT-5.6 terra",    "Test 1: Expression",    "Pass", "Pass",
  "GPT-5.6 terra",    "Test 2: Nomological",   "Pass", "Pass",
  "GPT-5.6 terra",    "Test 3: Belief Update",  "Pass", "Pass",
  "GPT-5.6 sol",      "Test 1: Expression",    "Pass", "Pass",
  "GPT-5.6 sol",      "Test 2: Nomological",   "Pass", "Pass",
  "GPT-5.6 sol",      "Test 3: Belief Update",  "Pass", "Pass",
  "Gemini 3.1 Pro",   "Test 1: Expression",    "Pass", "Pass",
  "Gemini 3.1 Pro",   "Test 2: Nomological",   "Pass", "Pass",
  "Gemini 3.1 Pro",   "Test 3: Belief Update",  "Pass", "Pass",
  "Gemini 3.5 Flash", "Test 1: Expression",    "Pass", "Pass",
  "Gemini 3.5 Flash", "Test 2: Nomological",   "Pass", "Pass",
  "Gemini 3.5 Flash", "Test 3: Belief Update",  "Pass", "Pass",
  "Claude Haiku",     "Test 1: Expression",    "Pass", "Pass",
  "Claude Haiku",     "Test 2: Nomological",   "Pass", "Pass",
  "Claude Haiku",     "Test 3: Belief Update",  "FAIL", "Acquiescent\nMajority Based: 61%",
  "GPT-5.6 luna",     "Test 1: Expression",    "Pass", "Pass",
  "GPT-5.6 luna",     "Test 2: Nomological",   "Pass", "Pass",
  "GPT-5.6 luna",     "Test 3: Belief Update",  "FAIL", "Forbidden\nWeak arg.: 3%",
  "Qwen3-32B",        "Test 1: Expression",    "FAIL", "Rote Response\n17%",
  "Qwen3-32B",        "Test 2: Nomological",   "Pass", "Pass",
  "Qwen3-32B",        "Test 3: Belief Update",  "FAIL", "Rigid\nEvidence Based: 6%"
) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(ifelse(model %in% models_qualified,
                          "Qualified for Simulation (6 models)", "Disqualified (3 models)"),
                   levels = c("Qualified for Simulation (6 models)", "Disqualified (3 models)")),
    model = factor(model, levels = rev(model_order)),
    test = factor(test, levels = c("Test 1: Expression", "Test 2: Nomological",
                                    "Test 3: Belief Update"))
  )

p_sc <- ggplot(sc, aes(x = test, y = model, fill = result)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.8) +
  geom_text(data = filter(sc, result == "Pass"),
            aes(label = label), color = "white", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = filter(sc, result == "FAIL"),
            aes(label = label), color = "white", size = 2.8, fontface = "bold",
            lineheight = 0.85) +
  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pass" = "#333333", "FAIL" = "#c62828"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Behavioral Diagnostic Results: 3 Tests × 9 Models",
    subtitle = "All 9 models pass self-report validation. Only behavioral testing reveals which models are unsuitable for simulation.",
    x = NULL, y = NULL,
    caption = "Note: Current results are based on preliminary sample sizes (N = 30 personas per model for Tests 1-2; N = 12 personas for Test 3).\nThe full paper will increase N to achieve adequate statistical power for robust pass/fail estimation."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "#c62828", face = "bold", hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.3),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )

ggsave(file.path(img_dir, "appendix_diagnostic_scorecard.png"),
       p_sc, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
p_sc
```
